quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 IR deck, H1 2026 cumulative results beyond revenue and operating profit (page 4 chart, unit KRW 100 million): net income 191 (+334.0% YoY), earnings per share KRW 319 (+314.3% YoY), EBITDA 216 (+170.4% YoY) at a 37.1% EBITDA margin (+13.8%p YoY).

quarterly_data.signal: Revenue mix trend in the IR deck (page 5 chart): DRAM's share of revenue rose from 2% in 2022 to 10% in 2023, 23% in 2024, 27% in 2025 and 32% in 2Q 2026 (cumulative), while NAND fell from 97% to 87%, 75%, 71% and 65%; the company says revenue rose on growing demand for high-spec NAND and DRAM (HBM) and that DRAM (HBM) revenue keeps expanding from a NAND-centred revenue structure.

New-customer pipeline in the IR deck (page 7 chart): HBM products for two 'company S' IDMs and one overseas IDM are in Qual evaluation, with test completion and mass-production approval expected and approval / mass production expected in H2 2026; automotive MCU products for two overseas IDMs (test completion and mass-production approval shown in 2025, mass-production product being designed) with approval / mass production expected in H2 2026; and non-memory burn-in test products for power semiconductors at burn-in test companies (IDM being confirmed) with mass production expected in H2 2026.

quarterly_data.signal: Capacity: in May 2026 the company began construction to add a second-floor cleanroom at its new Osong plant to expand production capacity (IR deck, page 8 chart).
